description: Explicit composition requests (should invoke GBK, first tool create or capabilities)

fixtures.prompt: Compose a 16-bar Baroque fugue in D minor for organ.
Write me a short jazz piece in B-flat with a walking bass line at 140 BPM.
Make an ambient track, about a minute long, in C major with strings and choir.
Create a classical string quartet movement in G major, 24 bars, 3/4 time.
Generate a pop song instrumental at 120 BPM in A minor with piano, bass and drums.
Use GBK Composer to write a four-voice chorale in F major.
Compose a harpsichord minuet in the style of Bach, 16 bars.
I need a 30-second upbeat jazz cue for a video intro. Can you compose it?
Write a MIDI arrangement of an original melancholy waltz for cello and piano.
Compose a short fanfare for trumpets and horns in E-flat major.
Make me a lo-fi ambient loop in D with soft pads, 8 bars.
Write a three-voice invention for piano in A minor.
